rawSiteProfile.notes: SiteGround sgcaptcha WAF (NEW type, first in fleet). Bypass: iPhone UA via userAgentOverride + cookies cached via waf-cookie-manager. Desktop UA gets 403 post-challenge even with valid session cookie — iPhone UA is LOAD-BEARING. Store API primary: deep pagination (page=1/50/110) verified 200 via plain axios with cached cookies. HTML fallback /shop/page/N/ also works via cached cookies (safety net). Date filter verified monotonic: no_filter=11044, 14d=224, 1d=20. Same precedent as doctordeals.ca (Sucuri). Wait-strategy fix applied to waf-cookie-manager.ts (line ~113): wait for URL to leave /.well-known/sgcaptcha/ | /cdn-cgi/challenge-platform/ | /_Incapsula_Resource before extracting cookies. Regression-tested against Sucuri + Cloudflare — no regressions.
